description: Frozen files of PISA contract 2. A frozen file never changes: tests/test_frozen.py fails if one does. A change to the contract is a new minor (an additive schema change: bump x-pisa-contract, regenerate, and add a new entry here, keeping the old digest in 'history'), or a new major. A catalog never changes: a new component is a new catalog file (core:2) beside core:1 (CONTRACT-2 §12).

vendored.description: The official AG-UI 1.0 and A2UI 1.0 schemas, copied verbatim into vendor/ and pinned here by digest. vendor/SHA256SUMS must agree; refreshing them is a contract decision, made here and in SHA256SUMS together.
